articles.title: Fauci Lied Under Oath: Rand Paul Demands DOJ Prosecute NIH Chief for Perjury on Gain-of-Function Funding
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has formally referred Dr. Anthony Fauci to the Department of Justice for criminal perjury, alleging Fauci knowingly gave false testimony to Congress in 2021 when he denied NIH funded gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology. If proven, this means the man who shaped pandemic policy for three years lied to the American public and their elected representatives under oath. The implications for COVID-19 origin accountability and NIH institutional integrity cannot be overstated.

articles.title: Ivermectin in Oncology: Dr. Makis Names the Off-Patent Cancer Drugs Big Pharma Won't Let Oncologists Discuss

Patients abandoned by the standard-of-care machine deserve to know these options exist.

articles.title: Science Confirms It: Antidepressants Carry Real Harms That Prescribers Are Trained to Minimize
articles.summary: A candid scientific analysis of antidepressant benefits and harms confronts what the psychiatric establishment has long obscured: these increasingly mass-prescribed medications carry documented risks — including withdrawal syndromes, sexual dysfunction, and emotional blunting — that are systematically underreported in industry-funded trials. With prescriptions at all-time highs and the serotonin hypothesis of depression effectively debunked, the risk-benefit calculus millions of patients were sold may be fraudulent. The paper asks the questions regulators should have demanded answered decades ago.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid iLet Device Safety Failures From Investors and Patients — FDA Compliance Fraud Alleged

If the allegations hold, this is not just investor fraud — it means patients with diabetes were using a device whose safety profile was actively misrepresented to regulators and the public. The FDA's failure to catch this before market represents yet another breakdown in the approval system sold as a gold standard.

articles.title: COVID Billing Fraud at Scale: Texas Clinics Pay $20M After Disguising Nasal Swabs as Office Visits

This is not an isolated compliance error; it is a window into the institutionalized fraud that flourished under the cover of COVID emergency funding. Taxpayers were looted while the same system demanded public trust and compliance.

articles.title: Repurposed Drug Mebendazole Suppresses Gefitinib-Resistant Lung Cancer — Published Research the Oncology Industry Will Ignore
articles.summary: A peer-reviewed PLOS ONE study demonstrates that mebendazole — a decades-old antiparasitic drug costing cents per dose — can suppress tumor growth in gefitinib-resistant non-small cell lung cancer by targeting both EGFR signaling and microtubule dynamics simultaneously. Acquired resistance to EGFR-targeted therapy is one of oncology's most deadly dead ends, and a dirt-cheap repurposed drug may crack it open. Don't hold your breath waiting for a pharma-sponsored Phase III trial.
